worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.summary: Mirror one chosen target: a Pokémon yields its current types, a non-Pokémon yields its current armour. Friend or foe both work; you cannot mirror yourself, and pointing at the ground is invalid. A source with nothing readable or no actual change is refused.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.0: Copy the opponent's type to flip your matchups
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.1: Borrow a type from a friend or foe that hardens your defence
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.2: Take only the primary type and dodge a secondary weakness
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.descriptio: Range %1$s blocks, preparation %2$s. Copy a Pokémon’s current primary type; Mirror All also copies its secondary type.
Copied Pokémon types last %1$s and determine type matchups, same-type bonuses and type-based immunities.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.pair.0: Mirror both: copies the secondary type too, duration ×1.25, cooldown +14 ticks; the closest match.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.pair.1: Primary only: copies the first type, duration ×0.8, cooldown −8 ticks; avoids extra weaknesses from a secondary type.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 0.6 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 1.1 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.preference: On: copies the secondary type too, duration ×1.25, cooldown +14 ticks, the closest match. Off: copies only the first type, duration ×0.8, cooldown −8 ticks, avoiding extra weaknesses from a secondary type.
Look for a worthwhile source within this distance; larger will walk farther for a harder face, smaller only picks from close by.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to mirror a better source; off, it only picks from sources already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.world: Against a non-Pokémon, copy its current armour; Mirror All also copies armour toughness and knockback resistance. The copy lasts %1$s, ending on expiry or cleansing. Copied defences can be weaker than your own; later equipment and effects still change the result.
